# CellML model authoring

For an account-backed workspace, fetch the immutable Physiome exposure artifact with authenticated MCP and preserve its changeset, URL, bytes, license rule, and checksum. For local/offline work, pin those facts beside the local artifact. Use `LibCellMLBioModule` and libCellML parsing/validation/code generation; do not copy equations into handwritten replacements.

Trace CellML components and variables to friendly Biosimulant ports with explicit units. Document initialization, imported components, generated-code/runtime versions, numerical assumptions, and supported interventions in the model documentation when useful. Test source validation, unit consistency, mapped inputs/outputs, representative behavior, and reproducibility. Keep physiological interpretation and unsupported clinical claims explicit in caveats.

Keep the source-faithful time-course adapter on its supported temporal hook. Any
new finite preprocessor uses `execute(inputs, *, context)` with the imported enum
member `ExecutionPolicy.ONCE_BEFORE_RUN`; never use the invalid quoted uppercase
string `"ONCE_BEFORE_RUN"`.




Scientific qualification is removed. Legacy profile metadata is descriptive. Documents, evidence, reference fixtures and visualizations are not platform prerequisites. Preserve real execution errors, scoped authorization and files. File-only work needs no chart. For 0.0.38+, report inner failures with ExecutionOutcome through report_execution_outcome.
